stock.description: Meilleure Health International Industry Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, overseeing a broad spectrum of ventures in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and other international markets. Its diverse operations include industrial hemp, healthcare-related services, trading, various agency services, and both property investment/leasing and development. The company actively engages in the commerce of construction supplies, the creation and sale of residential real estate, property asset management, and the distribution of health-related goods. Furthermore, it provides real estate brokerage, services focused on the application of cannabidiol (CBD) derivatives, and comprehensive health management offerings, such as anti-aging treatments, aesthetic medicine, and general wellness consulting. It also acts as an agent for healthcare product sales. Formerly known as U-Home Group Holdings Limited, the company rebranded to Meilleure Health International Industry Group Limited in March 2017. Its primary corporate office is located in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
